svg.text: The laptop never talks to a VM until Entra ID has issued a token for the Azure VPN application and the gateway has accepted it; the private IP only answers from inside the tunnel.

svg.text: Every connection is recorded twice: gateway diagnostic logs and Entra sign-in logs. Controls: AC-17, IA-2(1), SC-8 (TLS tunnel), AU-2 and AU-12.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Generalised design: no client names, tenant IDs, addresses or data. Icons are simplified originals, not Microsoft artwork.
